name: loopweave-visible-bridge
description: Exactly-once same-task visible review bridge for LoopWeave

interface.shortDescription: Deliver reviews into one bound visible task.
interface.longDescription: Local model-free bridge that leases a pending LoopWeave review and delivers it exactly once into the currently bound visible Codex task. It never creates a hidden reviewer or replacement worker.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the LoopWeave visible review bridge status.
